name: codex-gardener
description: Silently queue Codex task lessons, curate them at the right scope, and audit local effectiveness without telemetry.

interface.shortDescription: Silently queue and curate reusable knowledge locally.
interface.longDescription: Silently queue bounded lessons from real Codex tasks without adding chat continuations, review them in scheduled maintenance, distinguish repository-specific knowledge from portable global knowledge, safely promote proven guidance, isolate concurrent repository writers with Git worktrees, and audit low-sensitivity effectiveness metrics entirely on the local machine.
defaultPrompt: Review this completed task and capture reusable knowledge at the right scope.
Curate repository and global learning candidates.
Coordinate repository writes with project ownership and isolated Git worktrees.
